## What's free

Pages (1 GB site, 100 GB/month soft bandwidth, public repos on Free), Actions minutes, GHCR for public images

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://github.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
